verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You shall cross the barren desert
But you shall not die of thirst

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You shall wander far in safety
Though you do not know the way

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines: You shall speak your words in foreign lands and all will understand

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines: You shall see the face of God and live

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Be not afraid
I go before you always

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Come follow me, and
I will give you rest

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines: If you pass through raging waters in the sea you shall not drown

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
If you walk amid the burning flames
You shall not be harmed

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
If you stand before the pow'r of hell
And death is at your side

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines: Know that I am with you through it all

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Blessed are your poor
For the kingdom shall be theirs

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Blest are you that weep and mourn
For one day you shall laugh

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
And if wicked men insult and hate you all because of me
Blessed, blessed are you!
